name: Fortnum & Mason Tea Tin
about: A London blend tea sold in a classic tin. Fortnum & Mason has been a Piccadilly landmark since 1707, so this tea is a well-known gift from the city.
tip: Online stock may show as sold out, so check with the store in person before you go.

name: London Gin
about: A gin distilled in London. London Dry is the classic style and the city's best-known spirit.
tip: Ask for the standard London Dry bottle if you want the classic style.

name: Liberty Tana Lawn Fabric
about: A fine cotton fabric with London-designed prints. Liberty has sold these patterns since the 1870s, making it a good gift for anyone who sews.
tip: Buy about half a metre for a small project, or a full metre for a dress or larger item.
